title: General Utility Functions
summary: This module provides a collection of general-purpose utilities for file downloading, asynchronous program execution, callback management for both synchronous and asynchronous operations, and adapting asynchronous modules for synchronous use.

nodes.label: Download Files from URL
nodes.title: dspy.utils.download
nodes.description: Downloads a file from a given URL, checking for existing files and their sizes to avoid redundant downloads.

nodes.label: Mark Function as Experimental
nodes.title: dspy.utils.annotation.decorator
nodes.description: A decorator used to mark functions or methods as experimental, indicating they might change in future versions.

nodes.label: Execute Program Asynchronously
nodes.title: dspy.utils.asyncify.async_program
nodes.description: Executes a given program asynchronously in a separate thread, managing thread-local overrides and concurrency.

nodes.label: Manage Thread-Local Overrides
nodes.title: dspy.utils.asyncify.wrapped_program
nodes.description: An internal helper function that wraps a program's execution to correctly handle and restore thread-local settings and overrides.

nodes.label: Manage Concurrency Limits
nodes.title: dspy.utils.asyncify.get_limiter
nodes.description: Provides a concurrency limiter (CapacityLimiter) to control the maximum number of concurrent asynchronous operations.

nodes.label: Handle Async Callbacks
nodes.title: dspy.utils.callback.async_wrapper
nodes.description: A wrapper for asynchronous functions that triggers start and end callbacks, managing call IDs and exception handling.

nodes.label: Handle Sync Callbacks
nodes.title: dspy.utils.callback.sync_wrapper
nodes.description: A wrapper for synchronous functions that triggers start and end callbacks, managing call IDs and exception handling.

nodes.label: Synchronize Async Modules
nodes.title: dspy.utils.syncify.SyncWrapper
nodes.description: A class that wraps an asynchronous DSPy Module's 'aforward' method, allowing it to be called synchronously.

nodes.label: External URL
nodes.title: External Resource
nodes.description: Represents an external web address from which files are downloaded.

nodes.label: Requests Library
nodes.title: Python Requests Library
nodes.description: The external Python library used for making HTTP requests to download files.

nodes.label: AnyIO Library
nodes.title: AnyIO Concurrency Library
nodes.description: An external library used for running asynchronous code in a separate thread, providing cross-backend concurrency primitives.

nodes.label: Thread-Local Settings
nodes.title: DSPy Thread-Local Overrides
nodes.description: Manages thread-specific settings and overrides for DSPy programs, ensuring isolation between concurrent executions.

nodes.label: DSPy Base Module
nodes.title: DSPy Module Base Class
nodes.description: The foundational class for all DSPy modules, providing core functionality and structure.

nodes.label: Callback Execution Logic
nodes.title: Internal Callback Handlers
nodes.description: Internal functions responsible for executing registered start and end callbacks for operations.

groups.label: File Management
groups.title: File Download Utilities
groups.description: Components related to downloading files from external sources.

groups.label: Asynchronous Execution
groups.title: Asynchronous Program Execution
groups.description: Utilities for running programs asynchronously, managing concurrency and thread-local contexts.

groups.label: Callback System
groups.title: Function Callback Handling
groups.description: Wrappers for functions to integrate pre- and post-execution callbacks for both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

groups.label: Module Adapters
groups.title: Module Synchronization Adapters
groups.description: Provides mechanisms to adapt asynchronous DSPy modules for synchronous execution.

groups.label: Development Utilities
groups.title: Development Annotation Tools
groups.description: Tools for annotating code, such as marking functions as experimental.
